description: This file contains tests for group runtime loading and behaviors in a chat application, utilizing the Vitest testing framework. It tests whether group runtime modules are loaded only when necessary and verifies the output of certain group-related functions.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: A test hook that resets plugin runtime state and module registry before each test.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for group runtime loading behaviors.

methods.name: groups.buildGroupChatContext
methods.description: Builds a chat context string for a group based on session context.

methods.name: groups.buildGroupIntro
methods.description: Builds an introductory message for a group chat.

methods.name: groups.resolveGroupRequireMention
methods.description: Resolves whether a group requires a mention based on configuration.
